meta.name: Tata Consultancy Services Ltd
meta.about: Tata Consultancy Services is the flagship company and a part of Tata group. It is an IT services, consulting and business solutions organization that has been partnering with many of the world's largest businesses in their transformation journeys for over 50 years. TCS offers a consulting-led, cognitive powered, integrated portfolio of business, technology and engineering services and solutions. [1]
meta.keyPoints: Revenue Breakup (Q2 FY27):[1] - BFSI: 32.8% - Consumer Business: 14.9% - Life Sciences & Healthcare: 10.3% - Manufacturing: 9.0% - Technology & Services: 8.6% - Energy, Resources & Utilities: 6.2% - Communication & Media: 5.8% - Regional Markets & Others: 12.4%
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 51.9%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 77.5%
cons: Stock is trading at 7.71 times its book value
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 10.2% over past five years.

announcements.text: Press Release - TCS Bancs For Treasury Marks Its Entry Into Sri Lanka With Indian Bank 19 Oct - TCS BaNCS for Treasury enters Sri Lanka with Indian Bank’s Colombo branch on October 19, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation 16 Oct - TCS scheduled a non-deal roadshow in the USA from October 22-27, 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Updates on Acquisition 15 Oct - TCS completed acquisition of BBY Services India LLP on October 15, 2026.

Press Release - TCS Launches Industrial Intelligence Foundry To Accelerate AI-Led Autonomy And Engineering 15 Oct - TCS launches Industrial Intelligence Foundry for industrial AI deployment, promising 25% faster new product introduction.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript 14 Oct - Transcript of earnings conference call for quarter and six-month period ended September 30, 2026

growth.text: Revenue compounded at 9.4% a year over 10 years (5y: 10.2%, 3y: 5.8%), from ₹1,08,646 cr to ₹2,67,021 cr.
Profit grew 7.3% a year over the same decade — slower than revenue, i.e. margins leaked.
Worst profit year: FY18 (-1.8%); best: FY19 (+22.0%).
Latest quarter Q2FY27: revenue +11.2% YoY, profit +7.0% YoY.

margins.text: EBITDA margin has ranged 25.9%–28.4% since FY15 (peak FY21, trough FY15); FY26 was 27.1%.
Q2FY27 operating margin of 25.7% is lower than 89.7% of the 87 quarters on record — near the bottom of its history.

returns.text: ROE was 49.0% in FY26 (range 30.2–52.7% since FY15).
Stripping out cash and investments, return on operating capital was 93.3% vs headline ROCE of 63.0% — the idle cash is diluting reported returns.
DuPont FY26: net margin 18.5% × asset turnover 1.6x × leverage 1.7x.

balance.text: Net cash of ₹35,613 cr (cash + investments less borrowings), 33.2% of net worth.

cash.text: Over 12 years the business generated ₹4,15,786 cr of operating cash flow (99.4% of reported profit), spent ₹34,295 cr on capex and paid ₹2,72,971 cr in dividends.
FY26 capex was 0.7x depreciation and 1.6% of sales — maintenance-level spending.
Cash conversion cycle of 93 days in FY26.

valuation.text: P/E of 16.6x vs 10-year median 26.8x (range 13.9–40.6x); cheaper than 94.6% of the last decade (z = -1.6).
EV/EBITDA of 11.7x vs 10-year median 18.5x (range 9.5–27.3x); cheaper than 94.1% of the last decade (z = -1.6).
P/B of 7.8x vs 10-year median 10.8x (range 5.3–18.2x); cheaper than 79.5% of the last decade (z = -1.0).
At its 10-year median P/E on current earnings, the stock would be ~₹4,090 vs ₹2,533 today (61.4%).

price.text: Stock down 17.3% over 1 year; 5y CAGR -5.7%, 10y CAGR 7.8%. Currently 44.4% below its all-time high of ₹4,554.
Versus BSE-500: -17.3% vs -10.4% over 1 year; since 2019, 3.9% vs 11.4% a year.

ownership.text: Foreign institutions cut their stake from 12.5% to 9.0% over 12 quarters.
Domestic institutions raised their stake from 10.0% to 13.6% over 12 quarters.
Promoters cut their stake from 72.4% to 71.8% over 12 quarters.
